claims.claim: A public route ensemble covers more FFE quotient surfaces below rho than either component selector alone.
The selected public routes preserve all audited selected-root pairs with no false positives on the current surface universe.
The remaining known miss is near the rho boundary under the fingerprint route but expensive under direct factor ranking.

limitations: This is a public selector over existing FFE quotient surfaces, not an end-to-end ECDLP algorithm.
The fingerprint route was validated by holdout splits over the current surface set; it still needs a pre-registered future-surface run.
Surface generation and factorization costs remain part of the cost model.
The route ensemble has not yet been integrated into the live AutoLab frontier queue.
next_required_validation: Freeze the route-choice policy before generating new surfaces.
Run the ensemble on a fresh transfer window.
Keep Pollard-rho accounting attached to materialization, factorization, and root recovery.
Try to close the single transfer-57 salt-164 miss with a cheaper public factor route.
